oracle.name: Microsoft.PowerFx.Interpreter
oracle.scope: The batch requests with their authored host contexts, executed by the unmodified official interpreter in two independent processes. Establishes the typed result or error for these requests only; clock-bypass and host-specific outcomes are declared where they differ.
